steps.label: inferact-v7x-16-01: 2 host(s), 16 devices
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
tpu-run bash -c 'hostname; test -f /run/tpu-ci-ready; docker info --format "{{.ServerVersion}}"; test "$(ulimit -l)" = unlimited'
TPU_RUN_TIMEOUT=600 tpu-run /opt/tpu-ci/venv/bin/python /opt/tpu-ci/smoke.py
